youtube_description:
We all know guitarist Christopher Amott from his career with the amazing ARCH ENEMY (the band his brother Michael founded in 1996), but do you know about ARMAGEDDON?

Christopher formed ARMAGEDDON in 1997 while he had some time off from ARCH ENEMY, and what started as a studio project is now a full blown band that mixes Christopher's extensive experience with some young musicians who were born to play Metal! Yes, Christopher is no longer part of ARCH ENEMY but he seems really happy to take ARMAGEDDON to the next level. Need proof? Catch the band on stage during their upcoming U.S. tour (dates below).

The band's NEW album is called 'Captivity and Devourment' and it's available now via Listenable Records.

We recently conversed with Christopher about ARMAGEDDON's lineup and NEW album, and about his life post-ARCH ENEMY. He also shared with us that he is currently working on an instructional video in order to inspire kids to kick ass in the guitar! Watch our EXCLUSIVE interview now!
